purpose: Training-free development experiment, not claimed paper reproduction or novel validated method
split: Fixed 20% task-stratified SHA256 seed42 subset; development only

arms.baseline: Historical unchanged direct inference, re-scored on exactly selected questions with frozen common parsers
arms.fixed: Global observation, fixed windows centered at 1/3 and 2/3 duration, final full-media answer
arms.agent: Global observation chooses first center; first local observation chooses second center; final full-media answer

base_input_policies.joint: Exactly copied historical preprocessing: both BF16, at most32 uniform frames; Omni first300s continuous audio, Video 8x2s endpoint-inclusive custom sampling inside first300s
base_input_policies.avspeaker: Exactly copied historical native preprocessing: Omni BF16 target1fps full audio; Video FP16 native8frames and8x2s native audio sampling

local_tool: Question-dependent or fixed12s synchronized excerpt, same dataset-specific adapter; x264 crf0 and uncompressed PCM16 MOV, no spatial crop. Model may access late audio beyond original300s prefix; additional access measured and shared budget fixed control provided.

parsers.joint: Frozen existing explicit-answer-v2-20261002, now prospectively fixed for new experiment; historical raw primary scores preserved
parsers.avspeaker: Frozen upstream actual first-letter plus strict parser; no random guess

selection_access: Input questions/options/task only, never correctness/labels/old outputs
inference_access: Input questions/options/media/model observations only; no labels, annotation captions, subtitle files, prior predictions or task-specific reference answers
runtime_failure: Preserve every attempt; OOM max3 attempts in a fresh worker; other errors stop lane for diagnosis
tool_failure: Invalid/ambiguous/out-of-range SEEK falls back to corresponding fixed center, logged; never parses executable code
pilot_gate: Two selected questions per dataset: shortest and longest; direct baseline media/token parity, same-seed repeat, functioning tool requests, final no truncation; no accuracy threshold
reporting: Per-task counts, strict denominator, parsed-only, errors/missing, final/intermediate truncation, gained/lost questions, agent-vs-fixed and baseline paired deltas, source-cluster bootstrap95%CI, runtime/tokens/frames/audio budgets
stopping_rule: One frozen20% run; no score-based stopping, resampling or prompt edits during run; no automatic80% or full evaluation
interpretation: Any gain is unproven until observed; four calls are equal-call budget not exactly equal FLOPs/tokens/unique evidence. Baseline vs agent includes extra compute and prompt effects. Diagnostic and prior baseline data have been inspected; remaining80% is not pristine unseen evaluation.
